summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, US equivalent of a Form 8-K submission) for the month of October 2026, signed by Director of Investor Relations Thiago Lofiego on October 30, 2026. The filing contains no transaction terms, no stake or per-share price, no premium, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no structural or regulatory detail beyond a set of embedded graphic exhibits. This is an ordinary periodic disclosure with no special-situation event disclosed. What to watch: any future 6-K disclosing a carve-out, stake sale, or strategic review, none of which is present here.
